description: Requires the connected Fold account. Saves standing laundry preferences applied to every future order: detergent (eco_unscented = unscented eco, free & clear, the default; or tide), waterTemp (mixed = standard: colors cold, whites warm, the default; cold; warm; hot), and specialInstructions (free text the facility sees on every order, max 500 chars; pass an empty string to clear). Only the fields you pass change.

specialInstructions.description: e.g. "hang-dry activewear, no fabric softener". Empty string clears.

name: update_care_preferences
title: Update laundry preferences
